what_it_does: Neural rendering—a technique that blends traditional 3D graphics with learned neural networks—requires enormous processing power to generate real-time images with shadows and complex material effects. NVIDIA's RTX 5090 graphics card is built specifically for this emerging workload. It combines powerful parallel processors (evolution of earlier generations) with specialized math units tuned for fast neural network inference using low-precision numbers, extra-wide pathways to fetch data from memory, and built-in hardware accelerators for ray tracing (simulating light bounce) and neural network evaluation.
